##### Project general facts

Celia Heights is a residential building by Abou Eid that offers a practical and comfortable approach to city living. The project features studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments with horizontally structured layouts, designed to make efficient use of space and natural light while providing a welcoming home for professionals, couples and small families.

Shared facilities are designed for relaxation and an active lifestyle. Residents can enjoy a swimming pool and a dedicated kids' pool, an indoor gym and an outdoor gym, as well as an outdoor cinema for evenings outdoors. A barbecue area and a fireplace lounge create spaces for gathering with friends and family, while a kids' play area caters to younger residents.

Apartments are delivered fully furnished, allowing residents to move into a complete, ready-to-live home with contemporary interiors and practical fittings.    

##### Location description and benefits

Majan is a residential district within Dubailand, offering a balanced setting with a mix of apartment buildings, community parks and everyday amenities. The neighbourhood is valued for its calm atmosphere and convenient position between several of Dubai's leisure and business destinations.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road runs along the district, with Al Ain Road close by, providing direct connections to the rest of Dubai as well as to Sharjah, Abu Dhabi and Al Ain. Dubai Miracle Garden, Dubai Studio City and Dubai Autodrome are all within a short drive.

Freehold ownership is available to international buyers. The combination of strong road connectivity, nearby leisure attractions and accessible apartment living positions the area for both end users and investors seeking practical homes in Dubailand.
